clues: This city sits on the south west coast of Turkey. High peaks stand just back from the shore.
High peaks trap wet air near the shore. That brings hard rain in winter, and summers turn very hot here.
A king built this city two hundred years before Christ. His name was Attalus, and Rome took the place soon after.
This place is the fourth most seen city in the whole wide world for trips. Only three famed world cities draw more guests from far lands each year.
This is Turkey's biggest sea resort, set on the Turkish Riviera. Guests fly in from all round the world to enjoy its sun and sea.
